summary: Senseonics Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into a Second Amendment to its existing Loan and Security Agreement with Hercules Capital and other lenders. The amendment increases the facility to up to $140 million in senior secured term loans, adding a $10 million funded Tranche 2 Loan and an additional $10 million Tranche 3A Loan at closing, alongside uncommitted tranches. Terms include interest at prime plus 2.40% (floor 9.90%), interest-only payments through October 2028, and maturity on September 3, 2029. This is a debt financing amendment, not a special situation; monitor future tranche draws and milestone achievements.
